title: Following directions
summary: Complete original route instructions using the stated meaning or lemma.

hotel.sentenceGloss: It is only a hundred metres from the stop to the hotel.
hotel.note: Genitive: до takes the genitive for a direction.

museum.sentenceGloss: There is a bus near the museum.

corner.sentenceGloss: The pharmacy is around the corner.
corner.note: Instrumental: за takes the instrumental here — за рогом.

oncorner.sentenceGloss: The kiosk is on the corner of two streets.
oncorner.note: Locative: на takes the locative — на розі двох вулиць.

left.note: Direction: ліворуч is an adverb and takes no case.

right.note: Direction: праворуч is an adverb and takes no case.

straight.sentenceGloss: Walk straight ahead to the park.
straight.note: Direction: прямо is an adverb and takes no case.

street.sentenceGloss: Cross the street at the green light.
street.note: Accusative: переходити takes the accusative — what is crossed.
